# ZELLIO

> ZELLIO is a software house and digital engineering agency based in Indonesia, providing website development, application development, business system development, and digital product engineering for businesses and organizations.

ZELLIO helps companies turn business requirements and operational needs into reliable digital products — from professional company websites and web applications to internal business systems, dashboards, mobile applications, SaaS platforms, and enterprise software.

ZELLIO serves businesses in Indonesia and international clients.

## Primary Services

- Jasa Pembuatan Website
- Jasa Pembuatan Website Perusahaan
- Jasa Pembuatan Aplikasi

- Jasa Pembuatan Sistem Perusahaan
- Jasa Pembuatan Dashboard
- Jasa Pengembangan Aplikasi Mobile
- Jasa Pengembangan Software
- Software House Indonesia

- UI/UX Design
- System Integration & API Development

## Website Development

ZELLIO develops professional websites for companies, brands, and organizations, including corporate websites, company profiles, marketing websites, business websites, and high-performance web experiences.

## Application & Business System Development

ZELLIO develops web applications and business systems around specific operational requirements, including internal company applications, management systems, workflow systems, customer portals, employee platforms, and business applications.

## Dashboard & Data Systems

ZELLIO develops administrative dashboards, operational dashboards, reporting interfaces, analytics platforms, and data visualization systems for businesses that need clearer visibility into their operations.

## Mobile Application Development

ZELLIO develops mobile applications for Android and iOS, including business applications, customer-facing products, operational applications, and mobile platforms connected to backend systems.

## SaaS & Digital Products

ZELLIO develops SaaS products, digital platforms, and web-based products with capabilities such as user management, subscriptions, integrations, dashboards, and scalable application architecture.

## Engineering Capabilities

- Frontend Development

- Software Maintenance & Evolution

## Development Approach

ZELLIO approaches projects based on business requirements, user needs, technical requirements, scalability, security, maintainability, and long-term product goals.

Typical project stages include:

1. Discovery & Requirements
2. Product & Technical Planning
3. UI/UX Design
4. Software Development
5. QA & Testing
6. Deployment
7. Maintenance & Continuous Improvement
